items.title: Show HN: Handcrafted HTML-first framework that outperforms React
items.contentSnippet:
Hi, I built an hancrafted HTML-first JavaScript framework called Places.js that outperforms React, Svelte, Lit, and Vue.
- Components are created with HTML-first templating, which allows for flexibility in how HTML is generated.
- No build step. Places.js can be downloaded from a CDN and directly added to a project.
- JavaScript enhanced web components that can be dynamically rendered with API endpoint data.
- Rendering agnostic stores that can be integrated with other frameworks.

items.title: The End of the Internet
items.contentSnippet: The old Internet, where anyone could host a server is over, but it's just the final blow in an ending that has been coming for years. The future, though, is brighter than it appears.

items.title: The focus on AI safety disasters ignores everyday harms
items.contentSnippet: Consider what passes for success in technology policy. An AI company promises that its chatbot will not encourage suicide. A social media platform makes it more difficult for children to buy fentanyl. These are important protections, and they should have existed all along. But companies can clear these low bars while continuing to make products…
